title: SCHC sender retransmits All-1 instead of aborting unrecoverable C=0 ACK
description: Correctness review: when an authenticated C=0 ACK reports every assigned regular bitmap bit received but RCS validation failed, handle_ack_frame() returns an ACK REQ and can treat All-1 as bitmap-retransmittable. All-1 is not a regular bitmap tile; with no repairable regular tile the sender must emit Sender-Abort and enter a terminal state. Add exact regression coverage.
notes: Review clarification: draft section 5.2 step 4 permits retransmitting All-1 when the ACK marks it missing, but that retransmission batch MUST omit the trailing ACK REQ. If all assigned bitmap bits are 1 while C=0/RCS failed, there is no repairable fragment and the sender MUST abort. Cover both branches.
